description: He wears an opaque brown ankle-length open outer robe with broad gold geometric woven borders over a cream long tunic embroidered in gold along the neckline and open front. A broad purple-brown-and-gold woven sash secures the waist with long fringed hanging ends. The lower layers cover his legs, and dark brown closed shoes carry gold ornament. Textile surfaces look substantial and finely woven; exact fibers are unverified. No headgear, armor or weapon appears.
